name: InputRichMessage

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: Content of the rich message to send described as a list of blocks

fields.name: html
fields.description: Content of the rich message to send described using HTML formatting. See rich message formatting options for more details. Use media field to specify the media used in the message.

fields.name: markdown
fields.description: Content of the rich message to send described using Markdown formatting. See rich message formatting options for more details. Use media field to specify the media used in the message.

fields.name: media
fields.description: List of media that are specified in the markdown or html fields using tg://photo?id=, tg://video?id=, tg://document?id=, and tg://audio?id= links

fields.name: is_rtl
fields.description: Pass True if the rich message must be shown right-to-left

fields.name: skip_entity_detection
fields.description: Pass True to skip automatic detection of entities (e.g., URLs, email addresses, username mentions, hashtags, cashtags, bot commands, or phone numbers) in the text

description: Describes a rich message to be sent. Exactly one of the fields html, markdown, or blocks must be used.
